newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MALAYSIA TENDERS TO SELL SEPT BUNGA KEKWA CRUDE.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA TENDERS TO SELL SEPT BUNGA KEKWA CRUDE.

text.p: Malaysia's oil trading company Petco has issued a tender to sell September Bunga Kekwa crude, industry sources said on Friday.
The tender is offering 250,000 barrels of the crude, loading between September 9-14.
It closes 1500 hours Kuala Lumpur time (0700GMT) with validity up to 1800 hours on the same day.
This is only the second cargo of the Bunga Kekwa crude to be offered since it started production at the end of July.
The first cargo of the medium sweet crude, loading in August, was sold by tender to British Petroleum at Tapis APPI -$1.00 per barrel.

The consortium developing the field is made up of Petronas Carigali, with 46.06 percent, Petrovietnam Exploration and Production with 12.5 percent, Canada's International Petroleum Corp with 26.44 percent and Sands Petroleum AB with 15 percent.
